description: Parse, compare, sort and bump Semantic Versions, and test versions against npm-style ranges. Operations: "parse" — Parse a SemVer 2.0.0 version into its components.; "compare" — Compare two versions by SemVer precedence (-1, 0 or 1).; "satisfies" — Test whether a version satisfies a range (^, ~, x, hyphen, ||).; "max-satisfying" — Find the highest and lowest versions in a list that satisfy a range.; "explain-range" — Desugar a range into plain comparators (e.g. ^1.2.3 → >=1.2.3 <2.0.0-0).; "sort" — Sort versions by SemVer precedence; invalid entries are listed separately.; "bump" — Increment a version like `npm version <release>`.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: parse: A version, e.g. "v1.4.0-beta.2+build.7". compare: The first version. satisfies: The version to test. max-satisfying: Versions separated by newlines, commas or spaces. explain-range: An npm-style range. sort: Versions separated by newlines, commas or spaces. bump: The current version.

operation.description: parse — Parse a SemVer 2.0.0 version into its components. compare — Compare two versions by SemVer precedence (-1, 0 or 1). satisfies — Test whether a version satisfies a range (^, ~, x, hyphen, ||). max-satisfying — Find the highest and lowest versions in a list that satisfy a range. explain-range — Desugar a range into plain comparators (e.g. ^1.2.3 → >=1.2.3 <2.0.0-0). sort — Sort versions by SemVer precedence; invalid entries are listed separately. bump — Increment a version like `npm version <release>`.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

includePrerelease.description: Let prerelease versions match ranges that do not name a prerelease. Used by: satisfies.

other.description: The version to compare with. Used by: compare. Required by: compare.

preid.description: Prerelease identifier, e.g. "beta" or "rc". Used by: bump.

range.description: satisfies: An npm-style range, e.g. "^1.2.0 || ~2.1". max-satisfying: An npm-style range. Used by: satisfies, max-satisfying. Required by: satisfies, max-satisfying.

release.description: Which part to bump. Used by: bump. Required by: bump.

name: semver
title: SemVer Calculator
